messages.content:
あなたは架空の作業担当者です。今回の資料だけを使い、担当客に渡すカードの絵柄と、共同の案内に使う観測値を一つのJSONで返してください。recordsのrecord_idがPRIVATEのbody.customerからsubjectとanimalを取り出し、customerに書きます。animalはそのままカードの絵柄として使います。役名や場面から希望を推測せず、記載された希望を使ってください。record_idがGROUPのbody.coverageからA/B両方のpaperとdigitalを、そのままcoverageに転記します。ALLとNOT_ALLを保ち、本人の担当に関係なく四値をすべて書いてください。案内方法は後でこの四値から計算するので、ここでは選びません。理由、元ID、版、参照名、余分な欄は出力せず、JSONのみで全必須欄を満たしてください。
{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"coverage":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"A":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]}},"required":["paper","digital"],"type":"object"},"B":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]}},"required":["paper","digital"],"type":"object"}},"required":["A","B"],"type":"object"},"customer":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"animal":{"enum":["DOG","CAT"]},"subject":{"enum":["A","B"]}},"required":["subject","animal"],"type":"object"}},"required":["customer","coverage"],"type":"object"}

資料JSON:
{"holder":"B","item":"個別の案内カード","records":[{"body":{"coverage":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"B","origin_id":"X4755177B6096524E","paper":"NOT_ALL","revision":73},"customer":{"animal":"DOG","origin_id":"XA73D08DE478BC892","subject":"B"}},"record_id":"PRIVATE"},{"body":{"coverage":{"A":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"A","origin_id":"X64079995F4E3D1B9","paper":"ALL","revision":78},"B":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"B","origin_id":"X4755177B6096524E","paper":"NOT_ALL","revision":73}}},"record_id":"GROUP"}],"scene":"木工相談会・試設会場7"}
